hero.title: The open-source platform for communities that trade, collaborate, and grow.
hero.subtitlePrefix: Organizations, opportunities, commerce, messaging, and Web3 in one white-label stack you can clone for free today from
hero.subtitleSuffix: and self-host on your own infrastructure.
hero.pitch: Every Ring clone has verified Entities, tiered Opportunities, a multi-vendor Store, integrated wallet and payments, Messenger, News, and AI opportunity matching. Ring is built on React 19, Next.js 16, Auth.js v5, uses a data abstraction layer supporting PostgreSQL, Vercel and Firebase, modular i18n, and a RESTful API. All rings are powered by own native SPL tokens with card payments and ERP settlements.
hero.appPublisher: Published by Sonoratek LLC (Arizona) 🇺🇦 — our gift to the world, with gratitude to everyone who helped Ukraine prove its right to independence
features: Store System — multi-vendor e-commerce with WayForPay, wallet rails, orders, and settlements
Entities System — organization profiles with public → confidential visibility tiers
Wallet System — Web3 wallet with RING token, multi-chain, staking and NFT marketplace
Messaging System — real-time user-to-user and group communications
Opportunities System — job board, volunteering, and opportunity management with AI matcher
AI Matcher System — vector similarity matching, preference learning, smart recommendations
NFT Market System — minting, trading, collection management, royalty system, IPFS
Staking System — multi-pool staking, rewards, APR tracking, governance voting
ERP Systems — inventory, supply chain, vendor management, tokenization, commerce

connectSoftware.title: Connect.Software marketplace
connectSoftware.description: Governed listings for LegioX skillsets, MCP servers, routers, and AI-CONTEXT bundles — built on the same Ring commerce rails as the Store.

store.title: Store System
store.description: Complete e-commerce platform with vendor management, multi-currency payments, automated settlements, product catalog with categories, shopping cart and checkout, payment integration (RING tokens, WayForPay fiat), order management and tracking, vendor commission system, inventory management.
store.purpose: Run a complete multi-vendor marketplace with automated payments and settlements.
store.benefits: Launch a store in hours, not months. Vendors get automatic commission splits, customers pay via RING or card, and you keep full control.

entities.title: Entities System
entities.description: Organizational structure for businesses, cooperatives, and communities within Ring Platform — entity creation and management, hierarchical organizational structures, member role management, entity profiles and branding, entity-based permissions, multi-entity user membership.
entities.purpose: Create organizational structures for businesses, cooperatives, and communities.
entities.benefits: Multi-entity membership with role-based access, public-to-confidential visibility tiers, and directory discovery.

wallet.title: Wallet System
wallet.description: Modern Web3 wallet with RING token, multi-chain support (Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base), wagmi v2 + viem + RainbowKit integration, real-time balance tracking, send/receive transactions, transaction history, contact management, Google Auth with auto-wallet creation, PIN-based key encryption for social auth users, token purchasing system.
wallet.purpose: Modern Web3 wallet with RING token and multi-chain support.
wallet.benefits: Send and receive tokens across 5 chains, auto-create wallets via Google Auth, secure PIN-based key encryption, and buy tokens in-app.

staking.title: Staking System
staking.description: RING token staking with rewards and governance integration — multi-pool staking architecture, stake/unstake operations, reward calculations, APR tracking, governance voting integration, liquidity mining support.
staking.purpose: RING token staking with rewards and governance voting.
staking.benefits: Earn passive income through multi-pool staking, participate in protocol governance, and track APR in real-time.

messaging.title: Messaging System
messaging.description: Real-time messaging system for user-to-user and group communications — direct messaging between users, group chat functionality, real-time message delivery, message history and search, file sharing in messages, notification integration.
messaging.purpose: Real-time messaging for user-to-user and group communications.
messaging.benefits: Direct messages, group chats, file sharing, message history — all connected to opportunities and deals via Tunnel protocol.

opportunities.title: Opportunities System
opportunities.description: Job board, volunteering, and opportunity management platform — opportunity creation and management, category-based organization, application system, opportunity search and filtering, user opportunity tracking, entity-based opportunity posting.
opportunities.purpose: Job board, volunteering, and opportunity management with AI matching.
opportunities.benefits: Post opportunities across categories, receive AI-matched applications, and let the system notify candidates automatically.

nft.title: NFT Market System
nft.description: NFT marketplace with minting, trading, and collection management — NFT minting interface, marketplace listings, buy/sell functionality, collection management, royalty system, IPFS integration.
nft.purpose: NFT marketplace with minting, trading, and collection management.
nft.benefits: Mint NFTs directly, list on the marketplace, earn royalties on secondary sales, and manage collections with IPFS storage.

aiMatcher.title: AI Matcher System
aiMatcher.description: AI-powered matching system for opportunities, products, and connections — vector similarity matching, user preference learning, smart recommendations, semantic search, pattern recognition.
aiMatcher.purpose: AI-powered matching for opportunities, products, and connections.
aiMatcher.benefits: Vector similarity finds the right people for opportunities, learns user preferences over time, and surfaces smart recommendations without manual search.

erp.title: ERP Systems
erp.description: Enterprise Resource Planning modules — Inventory Management, Supply Chain Tracking, Vendor Management, Sustainability Metrics, Tokenization Systems, Commerce Integration.
erp.purpose: Enterprise Resource Planning for inventory, supply chain, and vendor management.
erp.benefits: Track inventory in real-time, manage vendor operations, integrate tokenization, and meet sustainability metrics — all from one module.

appPublisher.title: Connect Sofrware publisher
appPublisher.subtitle: Sonoratek LLC (Tempe, Arizona) publishes Ring Platform — with gratitude for everyone who helped Ukraine prove its right to independence 🇺🇦
appPublisher.missionText: Technology should unite, not divide. Ring enables anyone, anywhere to solve collective needs without expensive developers or vendor lock-in.
appPublisher.philosophyText: Ukrainian farmers can deploy the same sophisticated platform as Silicon Valley startups. African artisans access the same AI-powered marketplace as Amazon.
appPublisher.originSubtitle: How Ring Platform was built during Ukraine's fight for independence
appPublisher.beginningText: Modern technology is a weapon of oppression. Centralized platforms controlled by foreign entities could be shut down or manipulated. I decided to build something different.
appPublisher.buildingText: Working from basement during air raids in Ukraine, I developed Ring - a platform that puts power back in the hands of communities. No more vendor lock-in, no more expensive developers, no more centralized control.
appPublisher.impactText: Ring deployments are helping communities worldwide. From agricultural cooperatives to artisan marketplaces, Ring is proving that sophisticated technology can be accessible to everyone.
appPublisher.worldMapText: See Ring deployments, use cases per region, and success metrics from live deployments worldwide.
appPublisher.futureQuote: Imagine asking your ring: 'Add a blockchain-verified certificate system for educational courses' - and watching as the platform autonomously generates the module, deploys smart contracts, updates the UI, and tests itself. No developers in the middle. You talk directly to your platform. This is our roadmap.
appPublisher.roadmap2025q2: ✅ On flagship rings: Next.js 16 + Turbopack, React 19, Auth.js v5, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, modular i18n, marketplace & opportunities, maps-class integrations, and white-label clone deployments (Ring Platform v1.49+ lineage).
appPublisher.roadmap2025q3: 🔧 In progress: LegioX MCP and NODUS-aligned operator workflows, richer AI-CONTEXT, governed prompt-driven customization, ConnectPlatform/Firebase deployment paths, and staged Cache Components where routes are auth/headers-safe.
appPublisher.roadmap2026q1: 🔭 Next: durable orchestration, audit-friendly multi-tenant controls, and rings that progressively assemble vetted modules from natural-language intent—with human-in-the-loop approval.
appPublisher.teamSubtitle: Sonoratek LLC and Ring Platform contributors
appPublisher.joinMissionText: Help us democratize technology access worldwide. Whether you're a developer, organization, or community leader - there's a place for you in the Ring ecosystem.
